game_concept: A tower defense set in The Kingdom – Castle Gatehouse, the fortified castle gatehouse: the knight must handle goblin raiders while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Variable Crates: Drag collected grain sacks into labelled variable crates, then read each crate's value to feed the royal vault.
theme: The Kingdom – Castle Gatehouse: the fortified castle gatehouse
core_gameplay_loop: In Castle Gatehouse, repeat each round: Drag collected grain sacks into labelled variable crates, then read each crate's value to feed the royal vault. Each round, goblin raiders strike the royal vault, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the crate_b value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Protect the royal vault from goblin raiders in Castle Gatehouse: keep the crate_b meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 42-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: crate_b drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 42-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 1 (intro tier): Variable Crates
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Variable Crates' (Week 1 slot 1), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Castle Gatehouse'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how crate_b changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against goblin raiders in Castle Gatehouse.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 42 seconds while crate_b > 0.
